# PR Merge Tracker

## Summary
After an agent opens a pull request, it keeps tracking it until it lands. A card in the conversation shows the PR, its required checks and reviews ticking over as they resolve, and one line on what the agent is doing right now. When a check fails, the agent reads the log and pushes a fix; when everything is green it merges — unless the person has turned "Merge when ready" off or stopped tracking. It replaces "go check CI and ping me" with a visible, interruptible commitment.

## When to use
- When an agent has opened a PR (adding an entry to `src/registry/index.ts`, a scout report from `npm run scout`) and the remaining work is waiting: CI, a preview build, a review.
- When the agent can respond to what happens on the PR on its own — fix a failing lint, answer a review comment, rebase — without the person relaying it.
- When the person may want the PR merged hands-off, but still needs to see what will be merged and stop it.

## When not to use
- When the agent can't act on PR events — a tracker that only mirrors the checks is just the PR page; link to it instead.
- For a single gate before going live with no code-review loop — use **Publish Gate**.
- For several long-running jobs at once — use **Background Tasks Drawer**, and open a tracker from there.
- When repository rules forbid automated merges: keep the tracker, but drop the auto-merge switch and end at "ready to merge".

## Anatomy
- **PR header**: a pull-request icon, the number and title, the head → base branches in mono, and a status pill ("Tracking", "Not tracking", "Merged").
- **Requirements list**: every required check and review in the order the PR page lists them ("npm run lint", "npm run build", "Workers Builds: ai-patterns", "1 approving review"), each with a pending, running, passed or failed icon.
- **Failure detail**: under a failed requirement, one sentence on what broke and where.
- **Status line**: a summary ("3 of 4 passed · merges when ready") and, beneath it, what the agent is doing ("Pushed 1 commit · checks restarted").
- **Footer**: a "Merge when ready" switch, a Merge button when it's off and everything has passed, and "Stop tracking".

## Behavior
- The card appears as soon as the PR is opened and stays in the transcript, always showing the PR's latest state.
- Requirements update live; an icon swap is the only motion, so a page of trackers stays calm.
- On a failure the detail line expands under the check, the status line says the agent is fixing it, then reports the pushed commit; the check goes back to running.
- With "Merge when ready" on, the agent merges the moment the last requirement passes and the header turns to "Merged". With it off, it stops at "ready to merge" and shows a Merge button; nothing merges without that click.
- Auto-merge stays on while checks are pending or re-running — a new push doesn't silently turn it off.
- "Stop tracking" ends all agent activity on the PR: no more pushes, comments or merges. The requirements dim and "Track again" picks up where it left off.
- After merging, the footer goes away and the status line says where the work landed ("PR Merge Tracker is in the catalogue").

## Content guidelines
- Name checks exactly as the PR page does, so the person can match them up; name reviews by what's required ("1 approving review"), not by reviewer.
- Write failure details as cause and place: "'Check' is defined but never used in demo.tsx", not "Lint error".
- Keep the activity line in the past or present tense of real actions ("Pushed 1 commit", "Waiting for the PR preview build"), never vague progress ("Working on it…").
- Say "Merge when ready" and "Stop tracking" literally; the person should know exactly what each one stops.

## Accessibility
- The card is a labelled `section` ("Tracking pull request #267"); requirements are a labelled list.
- Each requirement's status is in text (visually hidden "Passed", "Failed") as well as its icon, which is `aria-hidden`.
- The status line is a polite live region, so failures, pushes and the merge are announced.
- "Merge when ready" is a `switch` with `aria-checked`, labelled by its visible text; it's disabled once tracking stops or the merge has started.
- Spinners stop under `prefers-reduced-motion`; status changes are still conveyed in text.

## Related patterns
- **Publish Gate** — Use it when the agent's work goes live directly, with checks but no PR.
- **Agent Run Card** — Use it for the run that produced the PR.
- **Background Tasks Drawer** — Use it to list several tracked PRs at once.
- **Diff Summary Card** — Use it to show what the PR changes before it merges.
- **Scheduled Task** — Use it when the follow-up is time-based rather than driven by PR events.

## Default implementation (Tailwind v4 + Radix + Motion)

This is the catalogue's own reference implementation — use it verbatim when the
host project has no established design system, or when the user asks for
"the demoed look." When the host project has its own design system, treat
this code as a translation reference: keep every rule from the spec above
(Anatomy, Behavior, Content guidelines, Accessibility) and re-express the
markup, styling, and motion using that system's own components/tokens
instead of copying these Tailwind classes or the Motion API.

```tsx
"use client";

import * as React from "react";
import { AnimatePresence, motion, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react";
import { CircleCheck, CircleDashed, CircleX, Eye, EyeOff, GitMerge, GitPullRequest, LoaderCircle } from "lucide-react";

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

export type MergeConditionStatus = "pending" | "running" | "passed" | "failed";

export interface MergeCondition {
  id: string;
  /** What must be true before merging ("npm run build", "1 approving review"). */
  label: string;
  status: MergeConditionStatus;
  /** On failure: what broke, in one sentence. */
  detail?: string;
}

export type MergeTrackerStage = "watching" | "fixing" | "ready" | "merging" | "merged" | "stopped";

export interface PrMergeTrackerProps {
  /** Pull request number (267). */
  number: number;
  /** Pull request title ("Add PR Merge Tracker pattern"). */
  title: string;
  /** Head branch ("claude/kind-hawking-2v49zf"). */
  branch: string;
  /** Branch it merges into. */
  base?: string;
  /** Required checks and reviews, in the order the PR page lists them. */
  conditions: MergeCondition[];
  stage: MergeTrackerStage;
  /** One line on what the agent is doing right now ("Pushed a fix for the lint error"). */
  activity?: string;
  /** Merge automatically once every condition passes. */
  autoMerge: boolean;
  onAutoMergeChange: (value: boolean) => void;
  /** Merge now; only offered when ready and auto-merge is off. */
  onMerge?: () => void;
  /** Stop tracking the PR; the agent won't push or merge anything more. */
  onStop?: () => void;
  /** Resume tracking after a stop. */
  onResume?: () => void;
  className?: string;
}

const ICON = {
  pending: CircleDashed,
  running: LoaderCircle,
  passed: CircleCheck,
  failed: CircleX,
} as const;

const STATUS_TEXT = { pending: "Pending", running: "Running", passed: "Passed", failed: "Failed" } as const;

/**
 * An agent tracks the pull request it opened until it lands: required checks
 * and reviews tick over as they resolve, a failure turns into a pushed fix,
 * and the PR merges itself once everything is green — unless the person
 * turns auto-merge off or stops tracking.
 */
export function PrMergeTracker({
  number,
  title,
  branch,
  base = "main",
  conditions,
  stage,
  activity,
  autoMerge,
  onAutoMergeChange,
  onMerge,
  onStop,
  onResume,
  className,
}: PrMergeTrackerProps) {
  const reduce = useReducedMotion();
  const switchId = React.useId();
  const passed = conditions.filter((c) => c.status === "passed").length;
  const merged = stage === "merged";
  const stopped = stage === "stopped";
  const live = !merged && !stopped;

  const summary = merged
    ? `Merged into ${base}`
    : stopped
      ? "Not tracking · nothing more will be pushed or merged"
      : stage === "ready"
        ? autoMerge
          ? "All checks passed · merging"
          : "All checks passed · ready to merge"
        : `${passed} of ${conditions.length} passed${autoMerge ? " · merges when ready" : ""}`;

  return (
    <section
      aria-label={`Tracking pull request #${number}`}
      className={cn("flex w-full flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border bg-card", className)}
    >
      <header className="flex items-start gap-3 border-b px-4 py-3">
        <div
          className={cn(
            "mt-0.5 flex size-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full border transition-colors",
            merged ? "border-violet-500/30 bg-violet-500/10 text-violet-600 dark:text-violet-400" : "bg-muted text-muted-foreground",
          )}
        >
          {merged ? <GitMerge className="size-4" aria-hidden /> : <GitPullRequest className="size-4" aria-hidden />}
        </div>
        <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
          <p className="truncate text-sm font-medium text-foreground">
            <span className="text-muted-foreground">#{number}</span> {title}
          </p>
          <p className="truncate font-mono text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
            {branch} → {base}
          </p>
        </div>
        <span
          className={cn(
            "shrink-0 rounded-full border px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-medium",
            merged
              ? "border-violet-500/25 bg-violet-500/10 text-violet-700 dark:text-violet-400"
              : stopped
                ? "text-muted-foreground"
                : "border-emerald-500/25 bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400",
          )}
        >
          {merged ? "Merged" : stopped ? "Not tracking" : "Tracking"}
        </span>
      </header>

      <ul aria-label="Merge requirements" className={cn("flex flex-col py-1.5 transition-opacity", stopped && "opacity-60")}>
        {conditions.map((condition) => {
          const Icon = ICON[condition.status];
          return (
            <li key={condition.id} className="flex flex-col px-4 py-1.5">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                <AnimatePresence mode="wait" initial={false}>
                  <motion.span
                    key={condition.status}
                    initial={reduce ? false : { scale: 0.6, opacity: 0 }}
                    animate={{ scale: 1, opacity: 1 }}
                    exit={reduce ? undefined : { scale: 0.6, opacity: 0 }}
                    transition={{ duration: 0.15 }}
                    className="flex shrink-0"
                  >
                    <Icon
                      aria-hidden
                      className={cn(
                        "size-4",
                        condition.status === "passed" && "text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400",
                        condition.status === "failed" && "text-red-600 dark:text-red-400",
                        condition.status === "running" && "animate-spin text-muted-foreground motion-reduce:animate-none",
                        condition.status === "pending" && "text-muted-foreground/50",
                      )}
                    />
                  </motion.span>
                </AnimatePresence>
                <span className="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate text-sm text-foreground">{condition.label}</span>
                <span className="sr-only">{STATUS_TEXT[condition.status]}</span>
              </div>
              <AnimatePresence initial={false}>
                {condition.status === "failed" && condition.detail && (
                  <motion.p
                    initial={{ height: 0, opacity: 0 }}
                    animate={{ height: "auto", opacity: 1 }}
                    exit={{ height: 0, opacity: 0 }}
                    transition={{ duration: 0.2, ease: "easeOut" }}
                    className="overflow-hidden pl-[26px] text-xs text-muted-foreground"
                  >
                    {condition.detail}
                  </motion.p>
                )}
              </AnimatePresence>
            </li>
          );
        })}
      </ul>

      <div className="border-t px-4 py-2.5" aria-live="polite">
        <AnimatePresence mode="wait" initial={false}>
          <motion.p
            key={`${summary}|${activity ?? ""}`}
            initial={reduce ? false : { opacity: 0, y: 3 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
            exit={reduce ? undefined : { opacity: 0, y: -3 }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.15 }}
            className="flex flex-col gap-0.5"
          >
            <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-foreground">
              {(stage === "fixing" || stage === "merging") && (
                <LoaderCircle className="size-3 animate-spin motion-reduce:animate-none" aria-hidden />
              )}
              {summary}
            </span>
            {activity && <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{activity}</span>}
          </motion.p>
        </AnimatePresence>
      </div>

      {!merged && (
        <footer className="flex items-center gap-3 border-t px-4 py-2.5">
          <label htmlFor={switchId} className={cn("flex flex-1 items-center gap-2.5 text-xs", !live && "opacity-50")}>
            <button
              id={switchId}
              type="button"
              role="switch"
              aria-checked={autoMerge}
              disabled={!live || stage === "merging"}
              onClick={() => onAutoMergeChange(!autoMerge)}
              className={cn(
                "relative inline-flex h-5 w-9 shrink-0 cursor-pointer items-center rounded-full transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring disabled:cursor-default",
                autoMerge ? "bg-foreground" : "bg-muted-foreground/30",
              )}
            >
              <motion.span
                layout
                transition={reduce ? { duration: 0 } : { type: "spring", stiffness: 500, damping: 32 }}
                className={cn("size-4 rounded-full border bg-background", autoMerge ? "ml-[18px]" : "ml-0.5")}
              />
            </button>
            <span className="text-foreground">Merge when ready</span>
          </label>

          {stage === "ready" && !autoMerge && onMerge && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onMerge}
              className="cursor-pointer rounded-full border border-foreground/30 bg-foreground px-3 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-background transition-opacity hover:opacity-90 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring"
            >
              Merge
            </button>
          )}

          {live && onStop && stage !== "merging" && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onStop}
              className="flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full border bg-background px-3 py-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground transition-colors hover:bg-accent hover:text-foreground focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring"
            >
              <EyeOff className="size-3.5" aria-hidden />
              Stop tracking
            </button>
          )}

          {stopped && onResume && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onResume}
              className="flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full border bg-background px-3 py-1 text-xs text-foreground transition-colors hover:bg-accent focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring"
            >
              <Eye className="size-3.5" aria-hidden />
              Track again
            </button>
          )}
        </footer>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}
```
